title: Cerebrate Pixel 6 execution variants
description: How each model configuration executes: immutable variant ids (<model>/<variant>, named for what runs where at which precision), lifecycle status, stages, validation evidence, benchmarks with their measurement kind, resources, and the serving profile. Experimental reports stay in the ledgers; entries point at them. Checked with models/schema.json by scripts/validate-model-catalog.

investigations.description: Closed or deferred investigations, so they aren't repeated: what was tried, the outcome, and when to revisit.

status.description: validated = passed the validation stages, not served; staged = serving path built and tested beside production, not live; production = live (an MLServer endpoint, or a deployed profile a production endpoint can be pointed at); rejected = failed validation or not adopted.

selectable.description: false = used only inside another variant (e.g. a GPU fallback loaded in a TPU+GPU worker); can't be an alias or task target.

internal_fallback.description: <model>/<variant> loaded inside this one's worker and used when its preferred stage fails.

preparation.description: Compatibility transformations applied to the original model, each marked exact or approximate.

artifact.description: Artifact key of the model in models/catalog.yaml (absent for host steps).

precision.description: Compute precision. fp16-relaxed = fp32 graph on the Edge TPU with NNAPI's allow_fp16; host steps use n/a.

phase.description: image = once per image (cacheable); prompt = once per prompt.

metrics.description: Task-level metrics, named for what they measure.

record.description: Repo path#heading-anchor of the ledger entry.

measure.description: device = synchronized end to end on the phone (input write through output read) for the graph(s) named; worker = cerebrate-hetero's inference time; round-trip = from the guest through MLServer and back; summed = calculated from separately measured stages; connected = measured as one connected pipeline.

worker_config.description: Repo path of the cerebrate-hetero config the profile starts.

mlserver_model.description: Set only on the variant actually behind that MLServer endpoint.

runtime_files.description: Shared runtime files the worker config names besides the artifacts (e.g. libtensorflowlite_jni.so).
